{{Short description|German professor emeritus of experimental physics}}
{{about|the physicist|the biblical scholar|Hans Dieter Betz}}

'''Hans-Dieter Betz''' (born 29 September 1940) is a German professor [[emeritus]] of [[experimental physics]].

== Fields of research ==
Beside [[atomic physics]], Betz searched on [[Sferic]]s, where he leads a research group at [[LMU Munich]].<ref>[http://www.sferics.physik.uni-muenchen.de/ Sferics-science-group] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080410160818/http://www.sferics.physik.uni-muenchen.de/ |date=2008-04-10 }} der ''[[Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München]]''</ref>

Betz also investigates [[Radiesthesia]] and [[Dowsing]], ten years in Order by the [[German Government]].<ref>''[http://www2.pe.tu-clausthal.de/agbalck/biosensor/arte-2005.htm In der  Sache Wünschelrute] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081007115837/http://www2.pe.tu-clausthal.de/agbalck/biosensor/arte-2005.htm |date=2008-10-07 }}'' on ''[[Arte|ARTE]]'' 2007</ref> For example, the extensive [[Dowsing#Evidence|Munich ''Scheunenexperimenten'']].
